As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees
content: In 2025, Florida implemented solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys designed to attract Burmese pythons for removal efforts. Researchers tracked 346 pythons from 2017 to 2024 to study their climbing behavior. The study found that juvenile pythons are more likely to climb trees compared to adults. A recent competition in 2026 resulted in 280 pythons being removed by participants. Since 2017, over 19,000 pythons have been captured in Florida through organized efforts.

title: Delhi's Tanjot Singh wins INSPIRE award for wool-and-cotton HEPA alternative

Tanjot initiated this project under the INSPIRE-MANAK programme, gaining recognition for its environmental benefits. He received mentorship at IIT Delhi to refine his research and prototype development.

title: Illinois biker's $27.5m award cut by $10m; must accept or face new trial

title: Iowa will gives son 477.5 acres, daughters 107.83 each; challenge dismissed
